meta.title: Approvals on Master-Data Creation: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: The master-data creation approval flow and its availability or refusal for a non-Tenant Admin versus a Tenant Admin cannot be accessed or asserted by catalog steps.
Signing in as the specified users and verifying the tenant is on the Enterprise plan cannot be expressed.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The master-data creation approval flow and its availability or refusal for a non-Tenant Admin versus a Tenant Admin cannot be accessed or asserted by catalog steps.; Signing in as the specified users and verifying the tenant is on the Enterprise plan cannot be expressed.
